meta.title: If Your Cat Ever Stares At An Empty Corner… DO NOT LOOK
meta.notes: One line = one caption = one shot (unless transitionIn is 'hold', which keeps the previous shot on screen and applies the new shot's changes). Line timing comes from the generated voice audio: start(n+1) = start(n) + audioDuration(n) + pauseAfter(n).

beats.label: Directive 2: Do not turn on the light
Directive 3: Do not move the furniture
Directive 5: If your cat looks at you, do not move
Directive 6: When your cat falls asleep, take over

lines.voice: If your cat ever stares at an empty corner...
lines.caption: If your cat ever stares at an empty corner...

lines.voice: and does not blink...
lines.caption: and does not blink...

lines.voice: do not look.
lines.caption: do not look.

lines.voice: Do not ask it what it sees.
lines.caption: Do not ask it what it sees.

lines.voice: And do not stand between them.
lines.caption: And do not stand between them.

lines.voice: This advisory has six directives.
lines.caption: This advisory has 6 directives.

lines.voice: Most households violate the fourth.
lines.caption: Most households violate the fourth.

lines.voice: The addendum is not about the cat.
lines.caption: The addendum is not about the cat.

lines.voice: Your cat sleeps sixteen hours a day.
lines.caption: Your cat sleeps 16 hours a day.

lines.voice: It ignores its name.
lines.caption: It ignores its name.

lines.voice: It ignores the expensive bed you bought it.
lines.caption: It ignores the expensive bed you bought it.

lines.voice: It ignores you, mostly.
lines.caption: It ignores you, mostly.

lines.voice: But some evenings, it stops in the middle of the room.
lines.caption: But some evenings, it stops in the middle of the room.

lines.voice: Ears forward. Tail still.
lines.caption: Ears forward. Tail still.

lines.voice: And it stares at the corner by the bookcase.
lines.caption: And it stares at the corner by the bookcase.

lines.voice: There is nothing there.
lines.caption: There is nothing there.

lines.voice: Most of the time.
lines.caption: Most of the time.

lines.voice: Directive one. Do not look.
lines.caption: Directive 1. Do not look.

lines.voice: You will want to follow its eyes.
lines.caption: You will want to follow its eyes.

lines.voice: Everyone does.
lines.caption: Everyone does.

lines.voice: Look at the cat instead.
lines.caption: Look at the cat instead.

lines.voice: Notice how it sits.
lines.caption: Notice how it sits.

lines.voice: Weight back. Paws together.
lines.caption: Weight back. Paws together.

lines.voice: That is how it sits at the window when a bird lands.
lines.caption: That is how it sits at the window when a bird lands.

lines.voice: Your cat is not afraid of the corner.
lines.caption: Your cat is not afraid of the corner.

lines.voice: It is keeping it there.
lines.caption: It is keeping it there.

lines.voice: Directive two. Do not turn on the light.
lines.caption: Directive 2. Do not turn on the light.
emphasis: Do not turn on the light

lines.voice: Light does not make a corner empty.
lines.caption: Light does not make a corner empty.

lines.voice: It only makes it harder to see what your cat can see.
lines.caption: It only makes it harder to see what your cat can see.

lines.voice: Case four-one-one.
lines.caption: Case 0411.

lines.voice: A man in Bristol switched on every lamp in his flat.
lines.caption: A man in Bristol switched on every lamp in his flat.

lines.voice: His cat left the corner.
lines.caption: His cat left the corner.

lines.voice: It sat in the hallway.
lines.caption: It sat in the hallway.

lines.voice: And stared at a spot just behind his left shoulder.
lines.caption: And stared at a spot just behind his left shoulder.

lines.voice: He turned the lamps off again.
lines.caption: He turned the lamps off again.

lines.voice: We will not be putting that in writing.
lines.caption: We will not be putting that in writing.

lines.voice: Directive three. Do not move the furniture.
lines.caption: Directive 3. Do not move the furniture.

lines.voice: You will want to move the bookcase.
lines.caption: You will want to move the bookcase.

lines.voice: To prove there is nothing behind it.
lines.caption: To prove there is nothing behind it.

lines.voice: There never is.
lines.caption: There never is.

lines.voice: The corner is not behind the bookcase.
lines.caption: The corner is not behind the bookcase.

lines.voice: The corner is the corner.
lines.caption: The corner is the corner.

lines.voice: Move the bookcase, and the corner moves with you.
lines.caption: Move the bookcase, and the corner moves with you.

lines.voice: To the bedroom.
lines.caption: To the bedroom.

lines.voice: Leave the furniture where it is.
lines.caption: Leave the furniture where it is.

lines.voice: Directive four. Do not say hello.
lines.caption: Directive 4. Do not say hello.

lines.voice: This is the directive most households violate.
lines.caption: This is the directive most households violate.

lines.voice: You will be alone.
lines.caption: You will be alone.

lines.voice: It will be late.
lines.caption: It will be late.

lines.voice: You will feel silly.
lines.caption: You will feel silly.

lines.voice: So you will say it. Quietly.
lines.caption: So you will say it. Quietly.

lines.voice: Nothing will answer.
lines.caption: Nothing will answer.

lines.voice: That is not the problem.
lines.caption: That is not the problem.

lines.voice: The problem is that your household now has one more occupant than the census lists.
lines.caption: The problem is that your household now has one more occupant than the census lists.

lines.voice: In our files, two thousand three hundred and sixteen people said hello.
lines.caption: In our files, 2,316 people said hello.

lines.voice: Two thousand three hundred and sixteen addresses were added to a list.
lines.caption: 2,316 addresses were added to a list.

lines.voice: Your cat heard you say it.
lines.caption: Your cat heard you say it.

lines.voice: It did not look away from the corner for the rest of the night.
lines.caption: It did not look away from the corner for the rest of the night.

lines.voice: Directive five. If your cat looks at you, do not move.
lines.caption: Directive 5. If your cat looks at you, do not move.

lines.voice: Sometime after midnight, it will stop staring at the corner.
lines.caption: Sometime after midnight, it will stop staring at the corner.

lines.voice: It will turn its head.
lines.caption: It will turn its head.

lines.voice: Slowly.
lines.caption: Slowly.

lines.voice: And look at you.
lines.caption: And look at you.

lines.voice: Do not move.
lines.caption: Do not move.

lines.voice: It is not looking at you.
lines.caption: It is not looking at you.

lines.voice: It is looking at the space beside you.
lines.caption: It is looking at the space beside you.

lines.voice: The corner is empty now.
lines.caption: The corner is empty now.

lines.voice: Keep reading.
lines.caption: Keep reading.

lines.voice: It is a very good book.
lines.caption: It is a very good book.

lines.voice: We read the whole chapter.
lines.caption: We read the whole chapter.

lines.voice: Apologies.
lines.caption: Apologies.

lines.voice: That remark has been redacted.
lines.caption: That remark has been redacted.

lines.voice: Directive six. When your cat falls asleep, take over.
lines.caption: Directive 6. When your cat falls asleep, take over.

lines.voice: Cats are not built to stay awake all night.
lines.caption: Cats are not built to stay awake all night.

lines.voice: Yours has done this every evening for eleven years.
lines.caption: Yours has done this every evening for 11 years.

lines.voice: That is four thousand and fifteen evenings.
lines.caption: That is 4,015 evenings.

lines.voice: You thought it was ignoring you.
lines.caption: You thought it was ignoring you.

lines.voice: It was sitting between you and the corner.
lines.caption: It was sitting between you and the corner.

lines.voice: Every night.
lines.caption: Every night.

lines.voice: Tonight, its eyes close a little earlier.
lines.caption: Tonight, its eyes close a little earlier.

lines.voice: Let it sleep.
lines.caption: Let it sleep.

lines.voice: It will finally use the bed you bought it.
lines.caption: It will finally use the bed you bought it.

lines.voice: Sit where it sat.
lines.caption: Sit where it sat.

lines.voice: Face where it faced.
lines.caption: Face where it faced.

lines.voice: Keep your eyes on the floor.
lines.caption: Keep your eyes on the floor.

lines.voice: It does not need you to look.
lines.caption: It does not need you to look.

lines.voice: It only needs to know someone is there.
lines.caption: It only needs to know someone is there.

lines.voice: Addendum.
lines.caption: Addendum.

lines.voice: By now, you are wondering how a government department knows any of this.
lines.caption: By now, you are wondering how a government department knows any of this.

lines.voice: Every household receives a routine inspection once a year.
lines.caption: Every household receives a routine inspection once a year.

lines.voice: You have never met the inspector.
lines.caption: You have never met the inspector.

lines.voice: Your cat has.
lines.caption: Your cat has.

lines.voice: The Department of Unlisted Risks has inspected homes for one hundred and twelve years.
lines.caption: The Department of Unlisted Risks has inspected homes for 112 years.

lines.voice: Our inspectors are very thorough.
lines.caption: Our inspectors are very thorough.

lines.voice: And very patient.
lines.caption: And very patient.

lines.voice: They prefer to stand in corners.
lines.caption: They prefer to stand in corners.

lines.voice: It gives the best view of the room.
lines.caption: It gives the best view of the room.

lines.voice: Your cat has never let one finish an inspection.
lines.caption: Your cat has never let one finish an inspection.

lines.voice: That is why it is listed as a risk.
lines.caption: That is why it is listed as a risk.

lines.voice: If your cat is staring at a corner right now...
lines.caption: If your cat is staring at a corner right now...

lines.voice: it is not looking at nothing.
lines.caption: it is not looking at nothing.

lines.voice: Please continue behaving naturally.
lines.caption: Please continue behaving naturally.

lines.voice: And do not look.
lines.caption: And do not look.

lines.voice: This advisory has ended.
lines.caption: This advisory has ended.

S01.desc: Living room at night. Cat seen from behind, sitting very still, facing an empty room corner on the right. Window with moon top-left. Nothing in the corner.

S02.desc: Extreme close-up of the cat's face, front view, eyes wide open. The eyes do not blink for the whole shot. Very slow push-in.

S03.desc: Large eye pictogram in the centre; a red cross is drawn over it.

S04.desc: Person kneeling next to the cat, a speech bubble with a question mark that gets crossed out in red. Cat keeps staring right.

S05.desc: Cat on the left, corner on the right, a person standing exactly between them. A red warning outline pulses around the person.

S06.desc: Official advisory memo on off-white paper slides up into frame. Header: DEPARTMENT OF UNLISTED RISKS / ADVISORY 0001 / SUBJECT: DOMESTIC CAT, CORNER FIXATION. Six numbered directive lines (text partly redacted with black bars) and an ADDENDUM line at the bottom.

S06b.desc: Same memo. A red stamp VIOLATED slams onto DIRECTIVE 4 with a small screen shake.

S06c.desc: Camera pushes down to the ADDENDUM line at the bottom of the memo; the line is highlighted in blue, text stays redacted.

S07.desc: Cat curled up asleep on the floor; a clock beside it with a counter that ticks up to 16 h.

S08.desc: Person on the left calls the cat (speech bubble with three dots). Cat on the right, loaf pose, facing away. Nothing happens.

S09.desc: A plush cat bed with a price tag (89.99) sits empty. Next to it the cat sits inside a cardboard box.

S10.desc: Person on the left end of a sofa, cat on the far right end, facing away from the person. Keep this composition: it is reused in S67/S68.

S11.desc: Wide room. Cat walks in from the left and stops in the middle of the room (walk, then freeze mid-step). Window with moon.

S12.desc: Close side view of the cat: ears pointing forward, tail completely still. Two thin blue annotation lines point to EARS and TAIL with small mono labels.

S13.desc: Cat on the left, bookcase on the right with the corner next to it. A dotted gaze line draws from the cat's eyes into the corner.

S14.desc: Close-up of the empty corner: two wall lines meeting a floor line. Nothing there.

S14b.desc: Same corner. For 6 frames halfway through, the inspector silhouette is barely visible in the corner (opacity 0.06), then gone. Do not make it obvious.

S16.desc: Person in profile; head slowly turns toward the corner on the right, following the cat's dotted gaze line.

S17.desc: A row of five identical people, all with heads turned toward the same point off-screen right. Faint, dim grey.

S18.desc: Person looks down at the cat instead; a blue check mark appears.

S19.desc: Large side view of the sitting cat, calm, staring right.

S19b.desc: Same cat. Blue annotation lines: WEIGHT: BACK (arrow on haunches) and PAWS: TOGETHER (bracket on front paws).

S20.desc: Cat in the same sitting pose at a window; a small bird lands on the outside sill.

S21.desc: Cat facing the corner, calm. No threat markers.

S22.desc: Same as S21, plus a blue dashed boundary line drawing itself on the floor between cat and corner.

C2.title: DO NOT TURN ON THE LIGHT

S24.desc: Floor lamp switches on next to the corner (light cone, white). The corner is lit and still looks empty.

S25.desc: Cat squints at the brightly lit corner; the corner area is washed out (overexposed white glow) so details are lost.

S26.label: CASE FILE
S26.desc: Manila case folder with paper clip and a typed label: CASE 0411 / BRISTOL, UK. A red UNLISTED stamp in the corner.

S27.desc: Top-down floor plan of a small flat (4 rooms + hallway). Five lamp icons switch on one by one (0.25 s apart) until every room is lit.

S28.desc: Same plan, all lit. The cat marker moves from the living-room corner into the hallway.

S28b.desc: Hold: cat marker sits in the hallway, a small dotted gaze line points back toward the person marker.

S29.desc: Person standing, seen from the side. The cat (left) stares at a spot just behind the person's left shoulder; the dotted gaze ends in a small red circle in empty air behind the shoulder.

S30.desc: Lamps switch off one by one in reverse order; the plan goes dark.

S31.desc: A typed memo line appears letter by letter: 'SUBJECT REQUESTED THAT' — then a black redaction bar wipes over the rest of the line. A pen icon lifts away.

S33.desc: Person pushing the bookcase sideways away from the corner (struggling pose, small shake).

S34.desc: Bookcase moved away; behind it only bare wall and the corner.

S34b.desc: Same; a small blue check appears in the corner area.

S35.desc: Diagram view: the corner drawn large and bright, the bookcase faded to 20% opacity beside it.

S35b.desc: Only the corner remains; its lines brighten (thicker stroke, slight glow).

S36.desc: Floor plan; a blue triangle corner-marker sits in the living room. When the bookcase icon is moved, the marker slides along with it through the hallway into the bedroom.

S37.desc: Bedroom at night: bed on the left with a sleeping person, the corner right next to the bed. The cat sits at the foot of the bed, staring at that corner.

S38.desc: Back in the living room: bookcase returned to its place next to the corner. Blue check.

S40.desc: Callback to the advisory memo: the red VIOLATED stamp on DIRECTIVE 4 pulses once.

S41.desc: Person sitting alone in an armchair in a dim room; the cat on the floor staring at the corner.

S42.desc: Wall clock showing 23:47, second hand ticking.

S44.desc: Person (left) with a very small speech bubble reading 'hello' pointed at the corner (right).

S45.desc: The corner, completely silent: an empty speech-bubble outline floats near it and fades out. Music drops to silence for this line.

S46.desc: Census-style household form on paper: OCCUPANTS — ADULTS: 1, CATS: 1. A third line types itself in blue: UNLISTED: 1.

S47.label: RECORDED GREETINGS
S47.desc: Big number counts up to 2,316 next to a growing stack of case folders.

S48.label: ADDRESSES ADDED TO LIST
S48.desc: Same number; a list document scrolls behind it with addresses as redaction bars; a red pin icon drops on the number.

S49.desc: Cat's head turns briefly toward the person, ears flattened back, then back toward the corner.

S50.desc: Cat staring at the corner; a clock in the corner of the frame spins fast from night to morning; the window behind changes from moon to sun.

C5.title: IF YOUR CAT LOOKS AT YOU, DO NOT MOVE

S52.desc: Cat staring at the corner; small clock top-left reads 00:40.

S53.desc: Close-up: the cat's head turns slowly from the corner (right) toward the camera/left. Turn takes the full line.

S53b.desc: Hold on the cat's face, now looking at the viewer.

S54.desc: Person on the sofa reading a book (left). Cat (right) looks at the person; dotted gaze line toward the person.

S55.desc: Same, person frozen: red outline around the person, everything still.

S56.desc: The gaze line redraws and passes the person's head, ending a little to their left.

S57.desc: Closer on the sofa: the empty seat next to the person; the cushion has a slight dent as if someone sits there. Red circle around the dent.

S58.desc: The corner, empty. A faint dotted trail leads from the corner out of frame to the left (toward the sofa).

S59.desc: Close-up of the open book in the person's hands; a page turns.

SLIP1.desc: STYLE BREAK (slip): the frame turns grey-scale and softer. Over the person's shoulder on the sofa leans the inspector silhouette, reading along. Its faceless head is tilted toward the book. Brief tracking-line glitch at start.

SLIP2.desc: The inspector bust, centred, faceless, hat and coat collar. Slight carbon-offset jitter.

SLIP3.desc: A typed transcript line 'WE READ THE WHOLE CHAPTER.' gets covered left-to-right by a black redaction bar. A small stamp REDACTED appears.

C6.title: WHEN YOUR CAT FALLS ASLEEP, TAKE OVER

S64.desc: Cat sitting, eyelids half closed, head dipping slowly (fighting sleep).

S65.desc: Calendar pages flip quickly (years shown as small labels); a counter beside it reaches 11 YEARS.
S65.label: YEARS

S67.desc: Exact callback of S10: person on the left of the sofa, cat on the right end, facing away.

S68.desc: Same composition, camera pulls back and pans right to reveal the room corner behind the cat. The cat sits exactly between the person and the corner, facing the corner. A blue dashed line marks person → cat → corner.

S68b.desc: Hold. Window outside cycles quickly through night skies (three moon positions) to suggest many nights.

S69.desc: Older cat (slightly smaller, slower) staring at the corner; its eyes close a little, open, close again.

S70.desc: The cat curls up asleep in the plush cat bed (the 89.99 tag still on it).

S70b.desc: Hold; the price tag sways once.

S71.desc: Person lowers themselves to sit on the floor at the cat's old spot (cat bed with sleeping cat beside them).

S72.desc: Seen from behind: the person sits facing the corner, exactly where the cat used to sit.

S73.desc: Same, the person's head lowers to look at the floor. The corner fades slightly darker.

S75.desc: Wide, calm composition: cat asleep in its bed on the left, person sitting guard in the middle, corner on the right. A soft blue lamp glow behind the person. Slow pull-back.

S77.desc: Person standing next to the advisory memo, with a thought bubble '?'.

S78.desc: Official notice on paper: NOTICE OF ROUTINE INSPECTION — FREQUENCY: ANNUAL — NOTICE GIVEN: NOT REQUIRED. The last line is highlighted in blue.

S79.desc: A closed front door; a doormat; nobody there.

S80.desc: Close side view of the cat staring at the corner (cat large in frame left, corner right).

S81.desc: Department seal: circular emblem with a stylised eye inside a house outline, ring text DEPARTMENT OF UNLISTED RISKS, and EST. 1914 underneath. Slow rotation in of the ring text.

S82.desc: Full inspector figure: faceless, brimmed hat, long coat, clipboard at chest. Standing perfectly still.

S82b.desc: Same inspector, unmoving; a clock beside him spins hours away.

S83.desc: First clear reveal: the inspector stands in the room corner, dim grey, faceless, clipboard in hand. Carbon-offset shimmer on its outline.

S84.desc: High-angle view from the corner (as if seen by the inspector): the whole living room below, the person on the sofa reading, the cat on the floor looking UP into the camera.

S85.desc: Cat staring at the inspector in the corner. Next to the inspector, a clipboard form with checkboxes, most of them still empty.

S86.desc: Household record again. Next to 'CATS ........ 1' a red stamp slams: LISTED RISK.

S87.desc: Callback to S01: cat from behind staring at a corner, but the room is now drawn like the viewer's own: TV glow, sofa back in the foreground.

S88.desc: The corner, with the inspector barely visible (opacity 0.12) for the whole line.

S89.desc: Close-up of the inspector's clipboard: a checkbox 'OCCUPANT BEHAVING NATURALLY' gets ticked in blue.

S90.desc: Callback to S03: eye pictogram, red cross drawn over it.

S91.desc: The advisory memo from S06 slides down out of frame (closing).

END.desc: Black frame. A red rubber-stamp 'ONGOING.' slams in at -6° with a thud and small shake. Below it in small mono: NEXT ADVISORY: 0002. Hold 3.0 s, then cut to black.
